displayName: [Preview]: Microsoft Foundry hosted agents should not use denied container images
description: Helps organizations prevent hosted agents from using container images prohibited by organizational supply-chain requirements.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy.

List of full container image references or case-insensitive patterns that hosted agents are not allowed to use. Use a registry hostname followed by '/*', such as 'contoso.azurecr.io/*', to deny images from that registry.
